pairs.why: A's orange hero with dark tyres stands apart from the green ground by both value and hue, as the real cards do, whereas B's pale grey rover sits on mid-grey ground with little value separation.
A keeps the large white target against dark red, with a fairly dark green surround, close to the real card's value groups, but neither reaches the real card's dark vignette.
B's lighter yellow fins against dark grey blades and a dark purple shoe match the real card's bright-hero-with-dark-accents pattern slightly better than A's heavier orange.
B has the bright yellow glow behind the dark blue body that the real card shows, while A's background is a darker, flatter orange and its dark blue keys merge into the body.
B's orange background gradient and the evenly lit light-cyan hero sit nearer the real card than A's top glow and heavier dark underside.
A has a large bright hero with a glow behind it and strong separation from the purple wall, though B matches the real card's lighter floor.
Both are much brighter than the real dark, spotlit, vignetted stage, with a pink glow in the middle and no deep corners.
A's bush is a darker, deeper green with more shadowed value groups, closer to the real card's dark hero against light sky, while B's lime highlights make it too bright and flat.
